# Error Reference

> ⚠️ **Generated page** — do not edit by hand. Run `make wiki` to regenerate.

The server surfaces these error types. The **safety-refusal** errors (`TradingDisabledError`, `EpicNotAllowedError`, `DryRunError`, `ConfirmRequiredError`, `RiskLimitError`) are expected guardrails, not bugs — they mean the safety model blocked a request.

| Error | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `BrokerError` | Broker rejected the request. |
| `ConfigError` | Configuration error. |
| `ConfigMissingError` | Required configuration (credentials) is missing. |
| `ConfirmRequiredError` | Explicit confirmation is required. |
| `DryRunError` | Dry-run mode is enabled. |
| `EpicNotAllowedError` | Epic is not in the allowlist. |
| `PreviewError` | Preview-related error. |
| `RateLimitError` | Rate limit exceeded. |
| `RiskLimitError` | Risk limit exceeded. |
| `SessionError` | Session-related error. |
| `TradingDisabledError` | Trading is disabled. |
| `UpstreamError` | Upstream API error. |
